links.effect: Naive XGBoost had overall F1 0.860 but eOR 0.619; F1 ranged from 0.907 in Black male patients to 0.824 in Asian female patients (95% CI 0.571-0.947).
links.quote: In sex and racial subgroups, the “best” naïve model achieved the highest F 1 -score in Black male patients ( F 1 -score 0.907; 95% CI 0.859-0.947) and the lowest in Asian female patients ( F 1 -score 0.824; 95% CI 0.571-0.947; Figure 1 ).

links.outcome: Equalized odds ratio and overall accuracy/F1 after applying bias mitigation techniques
links.effect: All 3 mitigation techniques raised eOR from 0.619 (correlation remover 0.750, threshold optimizer 0.750, exponentiated gradient 0.667) with F1 0.861 vs 0.860 for correlation remover; residual unfairness remained and some subgroups decreased.
links.quote: We found that all techniques improved the eOR, with the largest improvements observed after applying correlation remover and threshold optimizer; application of these techniques resulted in an equivalent eOR of 0.750 ( Table 4 ).
